BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Tremor
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: When taking deflect damage, raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by half the difference between the dice rolls, up to {0} (rounded down). When affected by (~HatKeyword id="Hat_TremorBurst"/~), raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by {0}. At the end of each Scene, halve the stack (rounded down).

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Tremor X
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: When taking deflect damage, raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by half the difference between the dice rolls, up to X (rounded down). When affected by (~HatKeyword id="Hat_TremorBurst"/~), raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by X. At the end of each Scene, halve the stack (rounded down).

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Tremor - Superposition
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: When taking deflect damage, raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by half the difference between the dice rolls, up to {0} (rounded down). When affected by (~HatKeyword id="Hat_TremorBurst"/~), raise (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by {0}. At the end of each Scene, convert to (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Tremor"/~), then halve the stack (rounded down). Has all of the combined (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Tremor"/~) effects.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Tremor - Superposition
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: Can combine multiple (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Tremor"/~) effects. At the end of each Scene, convert to (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Tremor"/~), then halve the stack (rounded down).

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Tremor Burst
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: Raise the target's (~HatKeyword id="Hat_BreakStateLine"/~) by its (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Tremor"/~) stack.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Stagger Threshold
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: The Stagger Resist threshold at which this character becomes Staggered increases by {0}. Removed when recovering from Stagger.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Innate
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: Draw this page in addition to the normal draw at the start of the Act.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Discard
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: Remove a page from hand. When there are no pages available to draw, shuffle discarded pages into the remaining deck.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Poise
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: When rolling a die that can (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Crit_Keyword"/~), increase its maximum based on its original roll range, up to {0}. (~HatKeyword id="Hat_OnCrit_Keyword"/~), reduce the stack by the increase; (~HatKeyword id="Hat_FailCrit_Keyword"/~), reduce it by only 1.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Poise X
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: When rolling a die that can (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Crit_Keyword"/~), increase its maximum based on its original roll range, up to X/2 (rounded up). (~HatKeyword id="Hat_OnCrit_Keyword"/~), reduce the stack by the increase; (~HatKeyword id="Hat_FailCrit_Keyword"/~), reduce it by only 1.

BattleEffectTextExtra.Name: Crit
BattleEffectTextExtra.Desc: If this die can (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Crit_Keyword"/~) and its base roll exceeds its original maximum, this roll is a (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Crit_Keyword"/~). (Offensive dice can (~HatKeyword id="Hat_Crit_Keyword"/~).)
